portal_family: IBM i CGI (casinqcgi-bin/wci01xr.pgm) — county-built JIS front end
verification_note: Clerk site case-search page iframes weba.claytoncountyga.gov/casinqsvr. Sample GET wci010r.pgm?rtype=E&ctt=M&cyr=2026&ctp=CM&csq=00100 returned case 2026CM00100: landlord plaintiff vs tenant defendant, case type 'Patho Dispossessory', filing 01/02/2026, defendant street address, docket + disposition. Server-rendered HTML, no login, no CAPTCHA.
known_limitations: No date-range or case-type browse; enumeration is by walking sequential case numbers per year/type
Docket shows 'Image Document' entries but images are not served publicly
Tenant-defendant is often not the property owner — eviction signals a landlord-side lead (tired landlord) and must be matched to parcel owner via enrichment
